results.question: Welcher Trainer hatte die längste Amtszeit bei den Falken?
results.actual_answer: Der Trainer mit der längsten Amtszeit bei den Falken war Rico Rossi sr., der vom 2004-09-01 bis 2013-05-31 im Amt war. Seine Amtszeit betrug 3194 Tage über 9 Saisons.
results.sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.name, ct.start_date, ct.end_date,
         LAG(ct.end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY ct.coach_id ORDER BY ct.start_date) AS prev_end
  FROM coach_tenures ct
  JOIN coaches c ON c.id = ct.coach_id
  JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = ct.team_id
  WHERE tm.name = 'Heilbronner Falken'
), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_end IS NULL OR start_date - prev_end > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_spell
  FROM t
), spells AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_spell) OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY start_date
                                 ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS spell_no
  FROM marked
)
SELECT name, MIN(start_date) AS von, MAX(end_date) AS bis,
       COUNT(*) AS saisons, MAX(end_date) - MIN(start_date) AS tage
FROM spells GROUP BY name, spell_no
ORDER BY tage DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

results.actual_answer: In einer normalen Saison der DEL2 werden 52 Spiele gespielt (Saison 2025/26).
results.sql: SELECT season, games_played FROM season_standings WHERE league = 'DEL2' AND games_played > 0 ORDER BY season DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: Hat Stefan Della Rovere mehr als 30 Punkte in 2022/23?
results.actual_answer: Ja, Stefan Della Rovere hat in 2022/23 mehr als 30 Punkte erzielt, da er 38 Punkte hatte.
results.sql: SELECT points FROM falken_skater_stats WHERE similarity(player, 'Stefan Della Rovere') > 0.3 AND season = '2022/23' AND points IS NOT NULL ORDER BY similarity(player, 'Stefan Della Rovere') DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: Wie viele Punkte hatten die Falken in 2019/20?
results.actual_answer: Die Falken hatten in 2019/20 84 Punkte.
results.sql: SELECT points FROM season_standings WHERE team = 'Heilbronner Falken' AND season = '2019/20';

results.question: Welche Saisons hatte Dylan Wruck mehr als 75 Punkte?
results.actual_answer: Dylan Wruck hatte in den Saisons 2020/21 (78 Punkte) und 2019/20 (88 Punkte) mehr als 75 Punkte.
results.sql: SELECT season, points FROM falken_skater_stats WHERE similarity(player, 'Dylan Wruck') > 0.3 AND points > 75 ORDER BY season DESC;

results.question: Wer war Falken-Topscorer in der Klassenerhaltsaison 2015/16?
results.actual_answer: Der Falken-Topscorer in der Saison 2015/16 war Adam Brace mit 28 goals.
results.sql: SELECT player, points, goals, assists FROM falken_skater_stats WHERE season = '2015/16' AND points IS NOT NULL ORDER BY points DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;
